correctness.rationale: For every algebraically closed characteristic-three field, the unique pole has conductor 7; genus=6, p-rank=0 and the displayed six regular forms are a basis. The semilinear Cartier images are exactly omega2->omega0, eta0->-c^(1/3)omega0-a^(1/3)omega1, eta1->-d^(1/3)omega0-b^(1/3)omega1-omega2. Thus rank C=3 iff a nonzero, else 2, rank C^2=1 and C^3=0. The a-number is 6-rank C. The translation-invariance of a=0 follows from binomial(7,2)≡0 (mod 3). The included finite-field 81-case checker corroborates the universally quantified symbolic argument.

value.rationale: The locus is the entire coefficient-level a-number stratification of the natural genus-six p-rank-zero one-wild-branch family, not a selected point or arbitrary slice. The nonempty smooth codimension-one rank-jump and fixed higher Cartier filtration determine a structural Jacobian invariant not fixed by ramification data. Neither correctness nor mere computational novelty alone is treated as value; the role of a-number strata in positive-characteristic Jacobian geometry motivates the classification.
